item.description: Allegations of recruitment irregularities have surfaced at the Maradugochha Primary Agricultural Cooperative Society (PACS) in Odisha’s Sonepur district, prompting the administration to launch an inquiry. item.title: Odisha Congress MLAs leave for Bengaluru a day after party whip ahead of Rajya Sabha polls
item.description: Eight Congress MLAs from Odisha travelled to Bengaluru a day after the party issued a whip directing its legislators not to leave Bhubaneswar ahead of the Rajya Sabha elections, triggering discussions within political circles. The development has drawn attention as the whip had instructed all Congress MLAs to remain in the capital from March 13 to March 16 in connection with the Rajya Sabha polls. item.title: Woman killed in hit-and-run in Bhubaneswar, driver flees the scene
item.description: A woman was killed in a tragic road accident in Bhubaneswar after an unidentified vehicle allegedly ran over her while she was on her way to buy vegetables on Friday. The incident occurred in the Aiginia area under the jurisdiction of Khandagiri Police Station. item.title: 19 passengers narrowly escape as traveller falls into pond in Ganjam
item.description: A traveller vehicle carrying 19 passengers fell into a pond after losing control late at night near Nuagaon under the Sorada Police Station in Odisha’s Ganjam district. Fortunately, all passengers escaped with minor injuries, as the water level in the pond was low. According to reports, the passengers were returning to their homes in Hinjilicut from Kandhamal district when the incident occurred.
